registered_before: any work on D10-D13 and before any computation of D1-D9
source: owner 19/11: re-read notes/RESEARCH_NOTES.md and reports/*.md for further directions; directions written for the old count system (tree, support, tripwire, discount, calibration refresh) that no longer apply to the token model are not carried over

D10_incident_grouping.what: group alert episodes into incidents (same workload, overlapping in time) and label operational triggers from Kubernetes events (rollout, restart, failover) instead of dropping them (Gandalf / NoDoze style)
D10_incident_grouping.criterion: reported burden as incidents per day and as episodes per replica-hour on pulse-live-v5-1110 and pulse-live-v6-1117 normal; attack trials keep their own incident (no attack merged into an operational label)

D11_replica_consensus.what: an alarm of a workload in the same 0.5 s windows on most of its replicas is labelled workload-wide drift (all replicas changed together, e.g. an aging model), an alarm on one replica stays an attack candidate (ReplicaWatcher idea, training-free)
D11_replica_consensus.criterion: offline on v5 and v6: burden of the single-replica channel lower than the whole, campaign attacks (one replica) unchanged

D12_slow_and_onoff_attacks.what: campaign rates 0.5, 0.2, 0.1 actions/s and on-off timing for the final live run (adaptive attacker of the reports, A1-A4)
D12_slow_and_onoff_attacks.criterion: measured in the final live run (reported, not adopted on it)

D13_io_uring_blind_spot.what: check whether io_uring is reachable from the cluster pods (RuntimeDefault seccomp); if it is, add io_uring operations as tokens
D13_io_uring_blind_spot.criterion: if io_uring_setup returns EPERM in a production-like pod, record the path as closed by seccomp (the seccomp hook sees the attempt); otherwise design the token and measure overhead
